name: Steps
usage: Multi-step forms and wizards, the progress of an approval, onboarding

props.name: items
props.description:
The steps: `title`, optional `content` below the title, and `disabled`. Steps before `current` are finished,
the step at `current` is in progress and the rest are waiting.

props.name: current
props.description: Index of the current step, starting at 0.

props.name: status
props.description: Status of the current step: `error` marks it as failed.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the index of a step when it is clicked; without it, the steps cannot be clicked.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the steps, such as "Checkout progress".

fields.name: content
fields.description: Text below the title, such as what the step is about or when it was done.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: The step cannot be clicked (only matters with `onChange`).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Steps before `current` are finished and show a check mark; the current step uses the accent color.

examples.name: Clickable
examples.title: Clickable steps
examples.description: With `onChange`, steps are buttons: `Tab` focuses them and `Enter` / `Space` go to a step.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Vertical, small and error
examples.description:
`orientation="vertical"` for a narrow column, `size="sm"` for dense layouts, and `status="error"` marks the
current step as failed.
